components.name: Predictive Boolean-contact quotient bridge
components.project_addition: Specialize the active E001 coarse-contact candidate Contact_d(g) iff g<d to declared one-direction and bidirectional integer gap actions, and use the E002/P023 finite predictive quotient compiler to derive exact horizon-indexed contact-entry/exit class counts and the arbitrary-future signed coordinate K=ceil((d-g)/a). Prove that K carries exact +/-a quotient dynamics and is coarsest for the Boolean contact future language while explicitly refusing to extend that compression to richer rebound/material response languages without recompilation.
